blocks.text: One motion form for the chair and the head, kept while the room is open; it has no button of its own, the top bar is its only command. Before a motion: gold Publish motion. Once published the form stays filled in and the top bar reads plain Update motion plus gold Fill ballot (Edit ballot once the ballot is in). The engine keeps one prep end time per room (rooms.prep_ends_at, set through PATCH rooms/:id/prep): publishing sets now + 15 min, the same time keeps it, a new time moves it. Everyone else reads the motion read-only with the countdown.
